verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official, documented `cognee-cli` for running Cognee from the terminal. It covers remembering data, enriching memory and asking questions, plus `push` to Cognee Cloud, `report` for graph insight reports, and an offline `demo` that needs no API key; a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI.
